topic: IOC loses *₹309* on every LPG cylinder i
hook: IOC loses *₹309* on every LPG cylinder in November, rising to ₹370
hook_b: Your LPG cylinder costs IOC more than you pay. By how much?
tldr: Indian Oil projects LPG under-recoveries of ₹309 per cylinder in November and ₹370 in December.

beats.what: Indian Oil's finance director shared LPG losses per cylinder on a post-results call.
beats.why: Crude buying stayed volatile; IOC paid from $5 below to $12 above benchmark prices.
beats.care: Any LPG price change is the government's call; none was announced in this report.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Under-recovery means IOC sells LPG below its cost. Anuj Jain, Director (Finance), said it was ₹184 per cylinder in September and ₹229 in October, projected at ₹309 in November and ₹370 in December. IOC's Q2 net profit more than doubled to ₹21,630 crore on better refining margins. Russian crude was about 55% of its basket in H1, the Middle East 24%. Whether cylinder prices change was not discussed in the report.

cards.q: If LPG losses keep rising, who should bear them?
What was IOC's LPG loss per cylinder in September?
cards.why: ₹184 in September, ₹229 in October, projected ₹309 in November and ₹370 in December.

viz.verdict: Oil firms losing more on every cylinder

viz.l: IOC Q2 net profit, more than doubled

cover.label: IOC's loss per LPG cylinder, Nov (projected)

insight: The gap was ₹184 a cylinder in September; IOC projects it doubles by December.

learn.t: Under-recovery = the gap between a fuel's cost and the regulated price it is sold at.

watch: Whether the Centre compensates oil companies or revises cylinder prices.
